comment.body: Launching PowerToys and immediately losing the tray/process already describes the trigger. Submit a comment containing /bugreport immediately after one failed launch. Since the UI cannot stay open, run BugReportTool.exe from the PowerToys installation folder to collect the report, and review it for private information before attaching. Please also give the Windows build from winver; no additional reproduction steps are needed.
